{{Top|leg}}
'''Rancor-leather''' was a type of [[Leather/Legends|leather]] made from the hide of a [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]]. [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] sometimes wore [[Boot/Legends|boots]] made of rancor-leather.<ref name="Episode III novel">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref>
